name: Kikuchi Kumiko
source:
An Art teacher.
When Kumiko was a student, she dyed her hair with various colors, and ended up looking as colorful as a parrot. Due to her job as a teacher, she is not allowed to dye her hair, so she's frustrated because of that. At least she gets to keep her room decorated with lots of creepy objects.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
